solution.p: (a) To find the roots, we solve \left(5-2x\right)\mathopen{}\left(3x-2\right)^{2} = 0 for x. Either 5 - 2 x = 0, in which case \displaystyle x = \frac{5}{2}, or (3 x - 2)^2 = 0, in which case \displaystyle x = \frac{2}{3}}.
(b) Since the leading term is -18 x^3 and -18 x^3 \to -\infty as x \to \infty, we have \left(5-2x\right)\mathopen{}\left(3x-2\right)^{2} \to -\infty as x \to \infty.
(c) Since the leading term is -18 x^3 and -18 x^3 \to \infty as x \to -\infty, we have \left(5-2x\right)\mathopen{}\left(3x-2\right)^{2} \to \infty as x \to -\infty.
